faq.q: How much does Hamparyan Personal Injury Lawyers San Diego, APC charge?
faq.a: Hamparyan Personal Injury Lawyers San Diego, APC publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Hamparyan Personal Injury Lawyers San Diego, APC offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Hamparyan Personal Injury Lawyers San Diego, APC publishes a free initial consultation. The firm states it will visit clients in hospital or at home.

faq.q: Where does Hamparyan Personal Injury Lawyers San Diego, APC have offices?
faq.a: Hamparyan Personal Injury Lawyers San Diego, APC publishes one office, in San Diego. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.a: Hamparyan Personal Injury Lawyers San Diego, APC names seven attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: California does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: Are the case results Hamparyan Personal Injury Lawyers San Diego, APC publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Hamparyan Personal Injury Lawyers San Diego, APC publishes 78 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right.
